description: This file is the server entry point for a Remix-based web application. It handles incoming HTTP requests, performs server-side rendering using React, and manages responses for different user agents (bots and browsers). It also sets CORS headers and handles OPTIONS preflight requests.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, manages OPTIONS requests, and delegates to bot or browser handlers based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user agents using React streams and returns HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user agents, also using React streams and returns HTML response.
